articles.title: Netanyahu says Israel is not to blame for the flood crisis in Gaza, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses claims — including from the U.S.-backed Board of Peace — that Israel is blocking winter supplies to Gaza. Severe rains have flooded makeshift tents, worsening conditions in the enclave. Netanyahu blames Hamas for the suffering, accusing them of seizing aid for military use. British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz demand Israel allow aid into Gaza. Meanwhile, Iran reports a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The British military also reports an incident with a tanker there. In Gaza, Israeli strikes killed three people, as tensions continue despite a ceasefire.

articles.title: This Arab party is ready to join Gadi Eisenkot bloc in Israel, but with a condition
articles.description: Mansour Abbas has signalled that Ra'am could recognise Hamas as a terrorist organisation during coalition talks. The shift may ease Eisenkot's negotiations, although Liberman's objections and Haredi draft demands remain significant.

articles.title: Father, child among six Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza
articles.description: Israel has killed more than 1,600 people in Gaza since last year’s ‘ceasefire’, the enclave’s Health Ministry says.
